headline: Im Ga Young drops MV for 'Be Happier Than Me'
sub: An aching farewell ballad premieres on 1theK
caption:
Im Ga Young has released the music video for her new song 'Be Happier Than Me' (나보다 더 잘 살아줘).

The MV premiered on 1theK's official YouTube channel on Nov 28 at 6 PM KST. Have a listen and let us know how it hits!

📌 Source: 1theK official YouTube
